name: Castronuevo (Spain)
description: Divided by a blue diagonal band edged yellow from the upper hoist to the lower fly, red at the upper fly and green at the lower hoist.
history: The arms and municipal flag were approved by the full council of Castronuevo in its session of 20 June 2003 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 7 August 2003; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of a blue diagonal stripe fimbriated yellow from the upper hoist corner to the lower fly corner, the hoist triangle green and the fly triangle red.

features.role: band edged yellow from the upper hoist to the lower fly
